newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary competition agency okays Danubius takeover.
newsitem.headline: Hungary competition agency okays Danubius takeover.

text.p: Hungary's Competition Agency said on Tuesday it had approved the sale of hotel chain Hungaria Szalloda Rt to Danubius Hotels.
"The agency has decided to allow Danubius to purchase Hungaria Szalloda Rt," Competition Agency vice-president Janos Stadler told Reuters.
The decision clears the way for Danubius to purchase 85 percent of Hungaria for 8.125 billion forints.

The state privatisation agency APV Rt approved the deal in August on condition that the Competition Agency established that the total market share of the merged hotel chains did not exceed the maximum permitted 30 percent.
The price paid for the stake represents 173.8 percent of the face value of the shares.
The remaining 15 percent stake will be offered to employees with Danubius obliged to buy any shares not subscribed at the same rate of 173.8 percent of face value.
